title: D6 bites
description: User story under REQ-174 for DEFINE step 3 PR 7 (spec section 4 row 'D6 scans and the injectable probe runner'). D6 gets the four mechanical consistency scans the spec section 11.5 names: consistency:contradictions (two ACs on one story sharing a when clause with a negated then), consistency:unsatisfiable (a then naming a field no recordShape defines; a field defined in a [draft] recordShape counts as defined), consistency:duplicates (identical descriptions across stories, both fail), consistency:orphanInterfaces (no AC ownerRef and no REQ deliveredBy reaches it). D6 is already ackable per PR 5; flipping D6 into the biting set in src/cli/readiness.js is this PR's one-line change. Named false-positive guards: a negation inside a double-quoted substring in a then does not fire contradictions; a field defined in a [draft] recordShape counts as defined for unsatisfiable.
iWant: D6 to run the four substantive consistency scans and --check consistency to honour the recorded override at the current hash
soThat: two ACs on one story that contradict each other, a then that names an undefined field, duplicate descriptions across stories or an orphaned interface block the gate until the tree is fixed or the gate is acknowledged

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] given two ACs on one story with the same when clause and a negated then, when D6 runs, then consistency:contradictions fails the story naming both ACs.
[failure] given a then naming a field no recordShape defines, when D6 runs, then consistency:unsatisfiable fails the AC.
[happy] given the field defined in a [draft] recordShape, when D6 runs, then consistency:unsatisfiable passes the AC.
[failure] given identical AC descriptions on two stories, when D6 runs, then consistency:duplicates fails both.
[failure] given an interface no ownerRef and no deliveredBy reaches, when D6 runs, then consistency:orphanInterfaces fails it.
[must-not] given a negation inside a quoted string in a then, when D6 runs, then consistency:contradictions does not fail the story on it.
